draft_message_text.name: draft_message_text

handling_proof_point.name: handling_proof_point

report_draft_final.name: report_draft_final
report_draft_final.value: "report_draft"."state" not in ('sent', 'cancelled', 'expired') or ("report_draft"."fields" is null and "report_draft"."back_stack" is null and "report_draft"."ended_at" is not null)

reporter_profile_slot.name: reporter_profile_slot
reporter_profile_slot.value: ("reporter_profile"."device_id" is null and "reporter_profile"."owner_slot" = 'session') or ("reporter_profile"."device_id" is not null and "reporter_profile"."owner_slot" = "reporter_profile"."device_id")

reporter_profile_officer.name: reporter_profile_officer
reporter_profile_officer.value: ("reporter_profile"."role" = 'claimedOfficer') = ("reporter_profile"."officer_regency" is not null and "reporter_profile"."officer_position" is not null)

seeded_session_reporter.name: seeded_session_reporter
seeded_session_reporter.value: ("seeded_session"."kind" = 'reporter') = ("seeded_session"."reporter_id" is not null and "seeded_session"."staff_role" is null)

seeded_session_staff.name: seeded_session_staff
seeded_session_staff.value: ("seeded_session"."kind" = 'staff') = ("seeded_session"."staff_role" is not null and "seeded_session"."reporter_id" is null)

ticket_history_staff.name: ticket_history_staff
ticket_history_staff.value: ("ticket_history"."actor" = 'staff') = ("ticket_history"."actor_id" is not null and "ticket_history"."actor_label" is not null)
